title: USF Event Contract Schema
description: Draft JSON Schema for event and message contracts. Each declares its kind (event-workflow-kinds); event and message kinds additionally require a payload schema reference, producer, ordering, idempotency key, dead-letter policy, retention, and the canonical-vs-test-only flag before emission. Events MUST NOT be invented in implementation code. USF claims no full AsyncAPI compliance until concrete artefacts exist. Governs the ontology concept Event. GOVERNANCE ENVELOPE: instances MUST carry id, title, description, authorityLevel, lifecycleState, ontologyConcepts, taxonomyRefs, vocabularyRefs, and aiGuidance (schema-authoring-standard section 9/11); kind (artefact-kinds) and version are deviated/deferred (recorded per section 9.3). lifecycleState draft; not active.

authorityLevel.$comment: authority-levels value pinned to the registry authorityRole.

canonical.$comment: true = canonical event; false = test-only event.

allOf.$comment: An event/message contract must carry payload, producer, ordering, idempotency, DLQ, retention, and the canonical flag before emission.
